Intoniva `v0.3.0-alpha.47` testing build.

* Settings tabs stay visible while scrolling and make room for the keyboard while editing.
* Each settings section keeps its scroll position and unfinished reference-pitch input.
* Native settings rows show icons, current values and expanded state. Tuning and trainer note selectors use consistent dropdown icons.
* Restored policy links and release workflow references after the repository rename.

All app features remain free. Android 8.0 support, target API 36 and app permissions remain unchanged.

Google Play production access has been granted. Play release review and public
availability are separate from this GitHub testing release.

Half/double-time interpretations can remain ambiguous even with a strong rhythm
match. Song chord recognition remains experimental; this is not a claim of
universally accurate transcription.

The APK is debug-signed for direct testing and is not the Google Play bundle.
Use the attached SHA-256 file to verify the download. The app has no ads,
accounts, analytics, tracking, Internet permission, or advertising ID.

Policies: https://majkey25.github.io/Intoniva/legal/
Review and remaining publisher-identification checks: `docs/legal-and-accessibility-review-2026-09-08.md`.
